title: Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.17068v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these

translated_title: 通过程序进化发现有效的智能体记忆设计
translated_abstract: 程序进化为发现智能体记忆设计并研究其有效性背后的选择提供了一种有前景的方法。我们提出了MAPE，这是一个通过标准化生命周期接口和迭代的诊断-提议循环，从最小种子出发进化出完整记忆程序的框架。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验表明，相较于人工设计的基线方法，该方法可获得最高12%的绝对准确率提升，同时服务成本仅为基线的35%，进一步的评估还证明了该方法在不同服务骨干模型和基准之间的可迁移性。实证分析和消融实验识别并验证了两种反复出现的设计模式：保留原始对话作为可检索证据可以保存从提取记忆中遗漏的细节，而根据查询意图组合检索到的证据有助于回答模型有效地利用这些证据。将组合模块移植到五个现有的记忆系统中，均提升了这五个系统的准确率。
tldr: 该论文提出MAPE框架，通过程序进化自动发现智能体记忆设计，在仅35%服务成本的情况下实现最高12%的绝对准确率提升，并识别出保留原始对话证据和按查询意图组合检索证据这两种关键设计模式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MAPE, a framework that automatically evolves agent memory programs through program evolution, achieving up to 12% absolute accuracy gains at only 35% of the serving cost, while identifying two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence and composing retrieved evidence according to query intent.
